customManagers.description: Images started with `docker run` inside workflow steps (Trivy scan)

packageRules.description: Non-major updates in one PR per side
Non-major updates in one PR per side
pnpm comes from `packageManager` via corepack, in CI and in the Dockerfile; its own PR
Base and CI images in one PR (Node, Python, uv, Trivy)
Python minor upgrades (3.14 -> 3.15) need wheels of all dependencies and the CI image (uv:python3.x-...) updated by hand; only after approval on the dashboard
TypeScript 7 is the native compiler; vue-tsc builds on the JavaScript API of TypeScript 6. Only after approval on the dashboard
PostgreSQL major upgrades need a dump/restore of the data; CI stays on the major of compose.yml
Django feature releases (6.1 -> 6.2) in their own PR, only after approval on the dashboard; read the release notes first
